raw_blocks: From pre-show advertising to lobby activations, we deliver the engagement and results that drive performance.
Your Largest Cinema Advertising Opportunity in the US

Anchored by the only three national theater chains and prominent regional exhibitors, our best-in-class cinema advertising platform reaches hundreds of millions of moviegoers each year. This unrivaled scale leads to some of the highest ratings with Gen Z and young Millennials and connects to incremental audiences.
Programmatic Ads: Now Playing on the Big Screen

Brands now have unprecedented access to premium inventory in front of high-quality, opt-in, brand-safe content. Garner 100% human-viewed impressions via Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) or Private Marketplace (PMP) campaigns, all in real-time.

It’s one thing to believe in the power of advertising at the movie theater. It’s another to have the data that backs it up. NCMx, our proprietary dataset, transforms moviegoing behavior into actionable marketing intelligence to deliver on your campaign KPIs, from pre-campaign planning to post-campaign reporting and everything in between.
Cinema is #1 in Attention
Attention matters. The follow-up report we published on consumer attention reaffirms that ads on the big screen top all other premium video platforms for attention.
Two witches must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.
The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove that he's humanity's savior.
Hired to be a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford, Lowen Ashleigh's assignment takes a dark turn when she discovers chilling autobiographical notes.
Facebook engineer Frances Haugen and The Wall Street Journal reporter Jeff Horwitz blow the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

National CineMedia (NCM) is the largest cinema advertising platform in the US. With unparalleled reach and scale, we connect brands to young, diverse audiences through the power of movies and pop culture. A premium video, full-funnel marketing solution for advertisers, NCM enhances marketers' ability to measure and drive results. NCM’s leading preshow, The Noovie® Show is presented exclusively in 42 leading national and regional theater circuits – including the only three national chains: AMC Entertainment Inc., Cinemark Holdings, Inc. and Regal Entertainment Group. NCM’s cinema platform consists of 17,500+ screens in more than 1,350 theaters in 184 Designated Market Areas® (all of the Top 50).

Interested in joining our movie-loving crew to help enhance the cinema advertising experience for brands and moviegoers alike? Whether you’re looking for an opportunity in Sales, Operations, Creative, Digital, or something entirely different, we invite you to come join a fun, vibrant culture with passionate people who thrive on propelling us forward.
We’re a publicly traded company, so you can own a piece of the action, too.

As the U.S. representative for the Cannes Lions Festival of Creativity, NCM hosts the annual Young Lions competition, challenging top under-30 talent to answer a nonprofit brief. The winning Team USA heads to Cannes, France to compete—expenses paid. It’s kind of a big deal.
